description: Channel model derived from persona access patterns documented in external-personas.json and internal-personas.json. Each channel entry defines the interaction surface, authenticating personas, security model, rate limits, data projection, and audit obligations. Channel IDs are referenced in visual-architecture.json (L1 Channel Layer) and service-catalogue.json capability_mappings. Ten channels cover all persona interaction patterns identified in Step 4.

channels.name: Web Portal
channels.description: Browser-based authenticated online banking portal for personal customers (PER-001) and business customers (PER-002). Provides full account management, payment initiation (Faster Payments, CHAPS, international), direct debit and standing order management, statements, Open Banking account aggregation, and secure messaging. WCAG 2.1 AA compliant. The primary accessibility-first channel for customers who require desktop form factors or assistive technology.
channels.persona_context: Personal Customer (PER-001) uses for bill payment, mortgage management, and detailed transaction history. Business Customer SME (PER-002) uses for bulk BACS upload, multi-user payment approvals, and invoicing integration. HNW Client (PER-004) uses for portfolio valuation and private banking messaging.

auth_model.scheme: OIDC/OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code Flow with PKCE
auth_model.mfa: SCA-compliant: TOTP app or biometric-backed device confirmation

rate_limits.notes: Rate limits enforced at SVC-101 (API Gateway). Business customers with corporate approval receive elevated payment limits via role attribute from SVC-100.

data_projection.pii_exposure: High — full account balances, transaction history, personal details
data_projection.data_residency: UK only. Session tokens and personal data must not traverse non-UK CDN nodes.
data_projection.sensitive_data_masking: Account numbers masked to last 4 digits in default view. Full account numbers revealed only on explicit user action with re-authentication.

audit_requirements.log_level: All authenticated actions including read events for account balance and transaction history
audit_requirements.log_destination: SVC-103 (Audit & Logging) + SVC-111 (Audit Log Store WORM) for payment events
regulatory_basis: PRA operational resilience important business service evidence

channels.name: Mobile App
channels.description: Native iOS and Android banking applications for personal customers, SME business customers, and HNW clients. The highest-engagement channel — 70%+ of digital banking sessions originate from mobile. Provides the full transactional feature set of the Web Portal plus mobile-native capabilities: biometric authentication, real-time push notifications (SVC-053), in-app card freeze/unfreeze/limit controls (SVC-011), spend analytics, camera-based document capture for onboarding (SVC-050), and in-app secure messaging. Benchmarked against Monzo and Starling for UX quality.
channels.persona_context: Personal Customer (PER-001) is the primary user — daily transactions, instant notifications, card controls. Business Customer SME (PER-002) uses for real-time balance monitoring, payment approvals on-the-go, and expense management. HNW Client (PER-004) accesses portfolio valuation, client portal messaging with Wealth Advisor.

auth_model.mfa: Biometric (Face ID / Touch ID / Android BiometricPrompt) as SCA factor 1 (inherence). Device possession as factor 2 (possession).
standards: PSD2 RTS SCA Article 9 (dynamic linking for payments)

rate_limits.notes: Push notification rate limits prevent notification fatigue. Payment limits are configurable by customer in-app within bank policy bounds.

data_projection.pii_exposure: High — full account access equivalent to web portal. Device binding means stolen device token cannot be replayed from different device.
data_projection.data_residency: App data cached on-device is encrypted via platform keychain (iOS Secure Enclave / Android Strongbox). No unencrypted PII stored on device.
data_projection.sensitive_data_masking: Balance hidden by default on app launch (anti-shoulder-surf). Full balance revealed on explicit tap.

audit_requirements.log_level: All authenticated actions. Device fingerprint logged for session fraud investigation.
regulatory_basis: FCA Consumer Duty Understanding outcome (notification clarity)
FCA PS21/3 operational resilience (mobile banking as important business service)

channels.name: Open Banking API
channels.description: OBIE/Open Banking Ltd-compliant API surface for FCA-registered Third Party Providers (AISPs and PISPs). Provides Account Information Service (AISP) APIs for account balance and transaction data, Payment Initiation Service (PISP) APIs for Faster Payments initiation from customer accounts, and Variable Recurring Payments (VRP) for sweeping and emerging commercial VRP use cases. CMA Order performance monitoring and incident reporting obligations apply. TPP onboarding, consent lifecycle, and revocation managed by Digital Channels Service (SVC-017).
channels.persona_context: Third Party Providers (PER-006) — FCA-authorised AISPs (TrueLayer, Yapily, Bud), PISPs (Volt, Modulr, Token.io), and emerging commercial VRP providers. Customer consent is required and managed; TPP identity is verified via eIDAS/OBIE certificates.

auth_model.scheme: FAPI 1.0 Advanced Profile (OpenID Connect with PKCE + eIDAS/OBIE QWAC certificate validation)
auth_model.mfa: Customer SCA required at consent grant (delegated to CH-001 or CH-002 via App-to-App redirect). No direct TPP authentication to bank systems without customer SCA.
re_auth_triggers: Suspicious TPP activity detected by SVC-013
auth_model.token_issuer: SVC-100 (Identity & Access Management) — TPP certificate validation via OBIE directory

rate_limits.notes: Rate limits published in OBIE-mandated developer portal. Performance reported to CMA Open Banking monitoring. Emergency rate limit reduction permitted only with FCA notification.

exposed_domains: Commercial Banking Core (SVC-005) — business account data
data_projection.pii_exposure: Constrained to consented data scope. AISP can read account data only. PISP initiates payments but cannot read account data. Data minimisation enforced by SVC-017.
data_projection.data_residency: API response data routed via UK-hosted API Gateway (SVC-101). TPP does not receive UK GDPR-protected data unless consent scope includes it.
data_projection.sensitive_data_masking: Account numbers returned as masked reference identifiers (not sortcode/account number). PISP receives payment confirmation only — not payer account details.

audit_requirements.log_level: All TPP API calls with certificate identity, consent ID, customer reference (pseudonymised), and response status
audit_requirements.log_destination: SVC-103 (Audit & Logging). CMA Open Banking performance dashboard fed from SVC-112 (Observability Aggregator).
regulatory_basis: CMA Open Banking Order performance reporting obligation
FCA operational resilience Open Banking API as important business service

channels.name: Branch Terminal
channels.description: In-branch staff workstation for identity-verified account services, cash transactions, customer onboarding for those unable to complete digital onboarding, complaint intake, and vulnerability flagging. Provides branch staff (PER-056) with access to customer account data, payment initiation (for assisted payments), and referral workflows to specialist RMs and Wealth Advisors. Branch network is declining — remaining branches focus on complex needs, vulnerable customers, and business banking relationships.
channels.persona_context: Branch Staff (PER-056) — cashiers, customer service advisers, branch managers. Handles vulnerable customers who require face-to-face support per FCA FG21/1. Identity-verified account opening for customers unable to use digital onboarding (eKYC fallback).

auth_model.scheme: SAML 2.0 SSO via employee Active Directory / LDAP
auth_model.mfa: Hardware FIDO2 token (YubiKey or equivalent) as second factor. Role-based access enforced by SVC-100 ABAC policies.
re_auth_triggers: Privileged action (account closure, large payment override)

rate_limits.notes: Branch staff payments are subject to maker-checker for amounts above £10,000 (SVC-055 Workflow Engine). All branch transactions logged to Audit & Logging (SVC-103) with staff ID.

data_projection.pii_exposure: High — branch staff see full customer account details for service delivery. Access is role-scoped and logged.
data_projection.data_residency: Branch terminals connect via internal MPLS network — no internet traversal. Data does not leave UK.
data_projection.sensitive_data_masking: Full account numbers visible to branch staff for service delivery. Audit trail captures every data access event.

audit_requirements.log_level: All staff-initiated transactions and data access events including balance lookups
audit_requirements.log_destination: SVC-103 (Audit & Logging) + SVC-111 (WORM store) for payment events
regulatory_basis: FCA Consumer Duty consumer support outcome

channels.availability_target: 99.5% (branch network is declining investment priority; impact tolerance less demanding than digital channels)

channels.name: SWIFT Network
channels.description: Direct SWIFT participant interface for CBPR+ ISO 20022 cross-border payment messaging and correspondent banking. Treasury Dealers (PER-053) use the SWIFT interface to execute FX trades, manage nostro positions, and send CHAPS-equivalent treasury payments. Correspondent Banks (PER-008) use SWIFT to exchange settlement messages with the bank. SWIFT CBPR+ MT format coexistence ended 22 November 2025 — ISO 20022 MX messages are now mandatory.
channels.persona_context: Correspondent Bank (PER-008) exchanges ISO 20022 pacs.008 and camt.052 messages for cross-border settlement. Treasury Dealer (PER-053) uses SWIFT-connected treasury system for intraday FX and liquidity management.

auth_model.scheme: SWIFT PKI with HSM-backed BIC certificate. SWIFT Alliance Access / SAA Cloud as the bank's SWIFT gateway.
auth_model.mfa: SWIFT hardware token for Alliance operator authentication. No OAuth — SWIFT is a closed financial network.
auth_model.session_lifetime_minutes: N/A — persistent SWIFT connection managed by SAA Cloud
standards: FATF Recommendation 16 travel rule data requirements

rate_limits.notes: All SWIFT messages screened by SVC-051 (Sanctions Screening) before transmission. FATF travel rule data (originator and beneficiary details) mandatory for all cross-border messages.

exposed_domains: International Payments (SVC-010) — SWIFT message origination and receipt
Treasury Service (SVC-007) — FX and liquidity management
data_projection.pii_exposure: High — beneficiary and originator PII in ISO 20022 structured address fields. SWIFT CBPR+ mandates structured payer/payee data from November 2025.
data_projection.data_residency: SWIFT messages transit through SWIFT's European operating centres. UK entity data governed by UK GDPR. Data residency obligation managed by SAA Cloud configuration.
data_projection.sensitive_data_masking: No masking within SWIFT network — full structured data required for ISO 20022 compliance.

audit_requirements.log_level: All SWIFT messages (inbound and outbound) with full ISO 20022 payload for sanctions and FATF audit
regulatory_basis: FATF travel rule / UK Funds Transfer Regulations
SWIFT CBPR+ ISO 20022 enhanced data compliance
FCA PSR 2017 execution time records for cross-border payments

channels.availability_target: 99.9% (SWIFT network availability guaranteed by SWIFT SLA; bank's SAA Cloud instance targets 99.9%)

channels.name: Internal Portal
channels.description: Staff-facing web portal aggregating all internal banking systems into a unified authenticated interface. Provides: CRM and RM workflow for Relationship Managers (PER-050), credit analysis tools for Credit Analysts (PER-051), MLRO dashboard and SAR management for Compliance Officers (PER-052), treasury trading interface for Treasury Dealers (PER-053), fraud alert investigation queue for Fraud Analysts (PER-054), mortgage underwriting workbench for Mortgage Underwriters (PER-055), wealth advisory platform for Wealth Advisors (PER-057), payment operations exception queue for Operations Staff (PER-058), and SM&CR accountability dashboard for Senior Managers (PER-059).
channels.persona_context: All internal staff personas. Access is strictly role-scoped via SM&CR function attributes in SVC-100. MLRO functions receive segregated access to SAR data not visible to other compliance roles.

auth_model.scheme: SAML 2.0 SSO + OIDC federation for cloud-based applications
auth_model.mfa: Hardware FIDO2 (privileged roles: MLRO, Senior Managers, IT Operations). TOTP soft-token (standard internal roles).
re_auth_triggers: Access to PCI DSS CDE data (card data functions)
standards: Zero-Trust Policy Engine (SVC-113) for privileged access decisions

rate_limits.notes: Bulk data exports require manager approval via SVC-055 (Workflow Engine) for GDPR data minimisation compliance. SAR data accessible only by MLRO function holders.

exposed_domains: Compliance Core (SVC-015) — regulatory reporting and Consumer Duty dashboards
data_projection.pii_exposure: High — internal staff see full customer data scoped to their role. Privileged access sessions logged to Audit & Logging (SVC-103).
data_projection.data_residency: Internal portal served from UK data centres. Internal network only — not internet-accessible.
data_projection.sensitive_data_masking: Credit file data masked for non-credit roles. SAR data POCA-protected — visible only to MLRO function holders.

audit_requirements.log_level: All privileged actions including data access, modification, and approval events. SM&CR function-specific events logged with SMF designation.
audit_requirements.log_destination: SVC-103 (Audit & Logging) + SVC-111 (WORM store) for SM&CR conduct events
regulatory_basis: FCA SYSC systems and controls records
UK GDPR staff data processing records

channels.name: Regulatory Gateway
channels.description: Outbound file transfer and submission channel for regulatory reporting to FCA, PRA, HMRC, Bank of England, OFSI, and National Crime Agency. Delivers scheduled regulatory returns (COREP, FINREP, PRA 110 liquidity, Bank of England statistical returns), event-triggered notifications (material incident reports, breach notifications, SAR submissions to NCA UKFIU), and ad-hoc supervisory data requests. The bank is the data producer; regulators are the consumers. No inbound data channel (regulators do not push data via this gateway).
channels.persona_context: Regulator (PER-009) receives submissions via FCA RegData portal, PRA Connect, HMRC portals, and NCA UKFIU SAR Online. Compliance Officer/MLRO (PER-052) manages SAR submissions. Senior Managers (PER-059) are accountable signatories for regulatory returns.

auth_model.scheme: Regulator-specific portal credentials (FCA RegData, PRA Connect, NCA UKFIU SAR Online). SFTP with key-pair authentication for bulk file transfer.
auth_model.mfa: Regulator portal MFA as mandated by FCA/PRA (typically TOTP or SMS OTP). No bank-side MFA — authentication is to regulator systems.
standards: NCA UKFIU SAR submission XML schema

rate_limits.submissions_per_day: Schedule-driven (COREP monthly, FINREP quarterly, PRA 110 weekly)
rate_limits.notes: Submission schedule managed by SVC-015 (Compliance Core Service). AxiomSL or equivalent generates submission artefacts. All submissions logged to Audit & Logging (SVC-103) with submission reference and regulatory body.

data_projection.pii_exposure: Regulatory returns are aggregated/pseudonymised. SARs contain individual customer data under POCA protection. NCA-bound data classified TOP SECRET under POCA 2002.
data_projection.data_residency: Regulatory returns submitted to UK-hosted regulator portals. No third-country data transfer.
data_projection.sensitive_data_masking: SAR data encrypted in transit to NCA UKFIU. Regulatory returns contain statistical data — no individual customer PII except in SAR submissions.

audit_requirements.log_level: All regulatory submissions with submission reference, regulatory body, submission timestamp, and senior manager signatory ID
audit_requirements.log_destination: SVC-111 (Audit Log Store WORM) — regulatory submission records are WORM for 7 years
regulatory_basis: PRA operational resilience incident reporting obligations

channels.availability_target: 99.5% (submission-based; not a real-time channel. Regulatory return deadlines are the SLA driver.)

channels.name: Card Network Interface
channels.description: Real-time card scheme connectivity for Visa and Mastercard authorisation, clearing, and settlement. Serves both card issuing (SVC-011 — debit and commercial card authorisation) and card acquiring (SVC-008 — merchant transaction acquisition). Card network messages flow in both directions: inbound authorisation requests (from Visa/Mastercard on behalf of merchants) and outbound settlement files. PCI DSS v4.0 CDE boundary applies to this channel.
channels.persona_context: Card Network (PER-010) — Visa and Mastercard as scheme operators. This channel is not a human persona interaction — it is a machine-to-machine scheme connectivity channel. The bank acts as both issuer (for cardholder authorisation) and acquirer (for merchant settlement).

auth_model.scheme: Visa/Mastercard scheme TLS 1.3 with HSM-backed BIN certificate authentication. ISO 8583 (legacy) and ISO 20022 (migration path) message formats.
auth_model.mfa: Not applicable — machine-to-machine scheme connectivity. Authentication is hardware-based (BIN certificate in HSM).
auth_model.session_lifetime_minutes: Persistent connection maintained by card processor (Marqeta/Thredd)

rate_limits.notes: Authorisation throughput managed by card processor (Marqeta/Thredd). Bank's SLA commitment: 99.99% authorisation availability and sub-100ms response time per Visa/Mastercard scheme rules.

exposed_domains: Card Processing Service (SVC-011) — debit/commercial card authorisation
data_projection.pii_exposure: Cardholder data (PAN, CVV in authorisation path only). PCI DSS CDE scoped. No PAN stored in non-CDE services.
data_projection.data_residency: Scheme network routes via Visa/Mastercard global networks. PAN data at rest held in UK PCI DSS CDE only. Tokenisation used for all downstream processing.
data_projection.sensitive_data_masking: PANs are tokenised (by Marqeta/Thredd) before being passed to bank systems. Only the card processor holds the live PAN — all bank-side services use tokens.

audit_requirements.log_level: All authorisation decisions (approve/decline/refer) with transaction reference, masked PAN, merchant ID, and fraud score
audit_requirements.log_destination: SVC-103 (Audit & Logging). PCI DSS requires 12-month online retention of all CDE event logs.
regulatory_basis: PCI DSS v4.0 CDE audit log requirements
UK GDPR cardholder data processing records

channels.availability_target: 99.99% (Visa/Mastercard scheme rules require 99.99% issuer authorisation availability)

channels.name: Telephony
channels.description: Inbound telephone channel for retail and SME customers and a support channel for branch staff. Provides Interactive Voice Response (IVR) for balance enquiry, mini-statement, and payment initiation. Escalation to human agents for complex queries. Biometric voice authentication for frequent callers. Outbound capability via Notification Service (SVC-053) for fraud alerts and payment confirmation calls. Channel cost per interaction is £4-8 vs £0.10-0.30 digital — economic pressure drives substitution to digital self-service.
channels.persona_context: Personal Customer (PER-001) calling for account queries, lost card, fraud dispute. Business Customer SME (PER-002) for payment investigations. HNW Client (PER-004) for private banking service requests. Branch Staff (PER-056) using internal telephony for escalations.

auth_model.scheme: IVR PIN (knowledge-based) + voice biometric for returning callers (NICE Real-Time Authentication or equivalent)
auth_model.mfa: PIN + voice biometric satisfies knowledge (something you know) + inherence (something you are) as PSD2-compatible SCA
re_auth_triggers: High-risk transactions (new payee, address change, card cancellation)
auth_model.token_issuer: Telephony platform — not SVC-100 (no OAuth for telephony). Agent access to customer data via Internal Portal (CH-006) using agent's own SSO session.
standards: FCA Consumer Duty consumer support outcome (accessible telephony)

rate_limits.notes: High-value payments (above £1,000) via telephony require agent verification and are subject to fraud screening (SVC-013). Vulnerability indicators captured and flagged in customer profile per FCA FG21/1.

exposed_domains: Retail Banking (SVC-001) — account balances and transactions via IVR
Commercial Banking Core (SVC-005) — business account data via agent
Notification Service (SVC-053) — outbound fraud alerts and payment confirmations
data_projection.pii_exposure: Medium — IVR exposes balance and transaction summary to authenticated caller. Agent access is full account view.
data_projection.data_residency: Call recordings stored in UK-hosted call recording platform. Agent CRM data in UK only.
data_projection.sensitive_data_masking: IVR reads back masked account numbers. Agent displays masked card numbers per PCI DSS requirement.

audit_requirements.log_level: All authenticated IVR interactions and agent call records with customer reference, action taken, and agent ID
audit_requirements.log_destination: SVC-103 (Audit & Logging). Call recordings retained per FCA BCOBS complaint handling requirements.
regulatory_basis: FCA Consumer Duty consumer support outcome

channels.name: Corporate API
channels.description: Host-to-host API channel for large corporate clients (PER-003) integrating their ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics) and Treasury Management Systems (Kyriba, FIS) directly with the bank's payment infrastructure, cash management, and account reporting services. Supports bulk BACS/CHAPS payment file submission, ISO 20022 structured payment initiation, real-time intraday balance reporting (camt.052), account statements (camt.053), and FX rate feeds. Delivers the API quality and developer experience that corporate treasurers demand to prevent switching to API-first competitors (Wise Business, Revolut Business, Airwallex).
channels.persona_context: Corporate Client (PER-003) — large companies (£25m+ turnover) with dedicated treasury functions and ERP integration requirements. Relationship Manager (PER-050) onboards corporate API clients and manages API entitlements. Operations Staff (PER-058) monitor the corporate API exception queue for failed payment files.

auth_model.scheme: OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials Grant with mTLS client certificate (RFC 8705). Dedicated corporate client OAuth application per client.
auth_model.mfa: Corporate API is machine-to-machine — no human MFA. mTLS client certificate is the second factor (possession of private key in corporate HSM).
auth_model.session_lifetime_minutes: Access token lifetime 60 minutes. Automatic refresh via client credentials grant.
re_auth_triggers: Suspicious API activity pattern detected by SVC-013

rate_limits.notes: Per-client rate limits configurable by RM. High-volume corporates (payroll processors, large retailers) receive elevated limits under signed API usage agreement. Rate limits enforced at SVC-101 (API Gateway).

exposed_domains: Commercial Banking Core (SVC-005) — business account data and facility positions
International Payments (SVC-010) — SWIFT payment initiation and nostro reporting
Treasury Service (SVC-007) — cash management, notional pooling, FX rates
data_projection.pii_exposure: High — full business account data, transaction history, and payment beneficiary data accessible to corporate API client. Client data is the client's own data.
data_projection.data_residency: API responses served from UK-hosted infrastructure. ISO 20022 data stored in UK.
data_projection.sensitive_data_masking: No masking — corporate API clients receive full structured data per ISO 20022 standard for ERP integration.

audit_requirements.log_level: All API calls with client certificate identity, OAuth token ID, payment instruction reference, and response status
audit_requirements.log_destination: SVC-103 (Audit & Logging) + SVC-111 (WORM store) for all payment events
regulatory_basis: CHAPS ISO 20022 enhanced data audit trail
FCA Consumer Duty value assessment for corporate API pricing
PRA operational resilience corporate API as important business service component
